name: Dex Winrace
features: fair skin, auburn hair, blue eyes, Scottish features, rugged look, athletic build, mature face, visible wrinkles, distinguished look, thin mustache
bio:
The old smuggler from Scotland. He's known for coming from the British racing scene with raw talent and fearless racecraft. Dex lives for wheel-to-wheel battles.

As a funny fact, that's his real name... He won his first race recently and most of the jokes ended. Some still remain, though.
